description: This file contains unit tests for the I18NError entity in the OrangeHRM project, including tests for entity creation, duplication, and validation constraints.

classes.name: I18NErrorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the I18NError entity, including validation and constraint enforcement.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by truncating the I18NError table before each test.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntity
methods.description: Tests creation and retrieval of an I18NError entity with valid data.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntityWithDuplicateName
methods.description: Tests that creating an I18NError with a duplicate name triggers a UniqueConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntityWithNullName
methods.description: Tests that missing the required name field triggers an EntityMissingAssignedId exception.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntityWithNullDescription
methods.description: Tests that missing the required message field triggers a NotNullConstraintViolationException.
